module
  include "tca-common.tca"
  runtime (cxx_path="runtime/tca_runtime.h")
  annotation @name (cxx="MatMulScale")
  kernel matmul_scale
    param lhs tensor<f32,[M,N]>
    param rhs tensor<f32,[N,Q]>
    param scale f32
    ret tensor<f32,[M,Q]>
    dimvar a b c
    let output
      map on(lhs[a][b], rhs[b][c]) as(a,b,c)
        (l:f32, r:f32) -> f32: (* name(l) name(r))
      reduce(init=0.0f) on(acc:f32, %0:f32) as(a,c) -> f32: (+ name(acc) %0)
      map on()
        [scale] (v:f32) -> f32: (* name(v) name(scale))
    return output
